name: Brave Vault Injector
description: Fills logins from Brave Vault via its native host. The credential never reaches an automation agent.
_comment_key: Set a fixed "key" here before packing so the extension id is stable and matches the native-messaging manifest's allowed_origins. Generate with: openssl / chrome pack; then update EXTENSION_ID in crates/app/src-tauri/src/injector.rs.
